reviewer_role: Independent scientific, layout and privacy reviewer

visual_review.method: Individually inspected all 64 rendered page images. Final corrected pages 12 and 53 individually re-inspected; all other final images byte-identical to previously inspected images.
layout_checks: No clipped text, table overflow, missing glyphs or unintended blank pages
Final wording corrections fit without layout regressions

scientific_review.basis: Final complete-cohort independent statistical reconstruction and source-level report comparison to the published release 1.72 baseline.
scientific_review.primary_endpoint: Confirmed response OR stable disease maintained at least six months; five versus 23. The six-month criterion applies to stable disease, not necessarily every response.
scientific_review.primary_results_verified: Four predefined programmes; exact primary P values 0.264, 0.521, 0.447, 0.483; all primary BH-adjusted q values 0.521. Table medians and Hodges-Lehmann shifts agree with independently reproduced results.
scientific_review.secondary_and_sensitivity_checks: Objective response alone is secondary (two versus 26), with separate multiplicity correction. Prespecified scoring, dose and dose/liver sensitivities are accurately described; no nominal P below 0.05. Coarse secondary joint-stratum test and score-direction instability are disclosed.
scientific_review.membership_and_measurement: Exact fixed memberships and overlaps, within-sample coding-gene ranks, zero-versus-missing coverage and lack of validated clinical cutoffs are distinguished.
scientific_review.quality_limits: All 28 retained; 24 ISR and four IU libraries, low/variable transcript mapping and coding depth, archival-specimen intervals, unknown biopsy organ/purity and clinical imbalances are described. Median 834 days is the screening-to-post-treatment collection interval, not baseline tissue age at first dose.
scientific_review.interpretation: No validated positive or low-expression responder selection rule, personal probability, causal attribution to vactosertib, equivalence claim, or ranking upgrade.
scientific_review.case_baseline_preserved: Release 1.72 Monash functional evidence and overall SMAD4 VUS assessment, primary-report molecular corrections, Caris NS interpretation and noncanonical TGF-beta/ERK limits remain intact.
scientific_review.tissue_constraint: No new organoid or tissue-culture proposals.

privacy_review.public_case_annotations: Previously explicitly approved C16/C17 annotations, public case-record links and reviewed correspondence paraphrases preserved; no full emails, private attachment or contact details introduced.
privacy_review.pdf_metadata: Title/author/subject and standard document software metadata only; no private paths.

resolved_issues.resolution: Changed selected before inspecting outcomes to selected before inspecting pathway scores; checked in sealed image and extracted text.

resolved_issues.issue: Missing sentence punctuation in reference VR3
resolved_issues.resolution: Corrected to measurement. Exact membership; checked in sealed image and extracted text.

projection_note: Original local source-path inventory and website source paths omitted; approved PDF identity and scientific/layout/privacy checks retained.
